workflow.critical: Execute ALL steps in exact order
All generated test files must be JavaScript (not TypeScript)

OUTPUT PATH: ALL generated files MUST be written to {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ — this resolves to a folder INSIDE the ai-qa-framework/TestResult/ directory. NEVER write to any e2e/, tests/, src/e2e/, or any other folder found anywhere in the host project. If such folders exist in the host project they belong to the host project and must NOT be modified.

step.goal: Resolve suite name and story files

check.ask: Please provide the suite name (e.g., opt-in-link-generation):
Please provide the story file path(s) — optional, press Enter to skip. Multiple paths may be provided separated by spaces:
check.action: Store as {story_files} if provided; leave empty if user skips

step.action: Derive {story_id} from {suite_name} or the FIRST filename in {story_files}
If {story_files} is provided: parse into a list, read ALL story files completely, merge their acceptance criteria into one unified set, store {ac_count} = total unique ACs
If {story_files} is NOT provided: set {ac_count} = 0 and proceed with suite name only

Read {test_users} from config.yaml: - If NOT empty → use them when generating login/auth test steps; proceed to step 3 - If empty → ask the user: "I need test user credentials to generate authentication test cases. Should I: A) Fetch them from your database B) You provide them manually C) Skip — generate tests without real credentials (I'll use placeholders)" If A or B → load and execute workflow: {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/workflows/fetch-test-data/workflow.yaml If C → proceed with placeholder credentials and add a TODO comment in the generated spec
Skill generates: - Page Object file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/pages/{suite_name}.page.js - Spec file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/tests/{suite_name}.spec.js

step.goal: Self-review — verify artifacts and test quality

artifact-checklist.file: Page Object Model class — must exist at the exact path inside TestResult/
Playwright spec file — must exist at the exact path inside TestResult/

quality-checklist.check: Both files exist at the correct paths INSIDE {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ — FAIL if files are in any host project folder
Page Object file uses JavaScript (not TypeScript) — no type annotations, no .ts extension, no interface/type keywords
Page Object constructor accepts `page` parameter and assigns `this.page = page`
All locators use `this.page.locator()` or Playwright locator methods — no raw CSS selectors as strings outside locator calls
Spec file imports the Page Object using a relative path pointing to the pages/ folder
Spec file uses `test.describe` and individual `test()` blocks — not bare function calls
If {story_files} was provided: the number of test cases in the spec covers ALL {ac_count} acceptance criteria from ALL provided stories — at minimum one positive test per AC
Each AC has at least one negative test case (invalid input, missing field, auth failure, etc.)
No hardcoded base URLs in `page.goto()` — must use `baseURL` from Playwright config or config.yaml
No `page.waitForTimeout()` with arbitrary delays — use `page.waitForSelector()` or `expect().toBeVisible()` instead
Each test has meaningful assertions using `expect()` — not just navigation without assertions

Every URL path used in `page.goto()` calls is a valid, reachable route: a. Extract every unique path segment from all `page.goto()` calls in the spec (e.g., "/dashboard", "/auth/login") b. Cross-reference each path against `routes.pages` in {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/project.config.json c. For any path NOT found in project.config.json: read the host project source files to discover the correct route: - Check Next.js: host-project/pages/ or host-project/app/ directory structure - Check React Router: host-project/src/**/routes*, host-project/src/**/App.*, host-project/src/**/router.* - Check Vue Router: host-project/src/router/index.*, host-project/src/router.* - Check Angular: host-project/src/app/**/app-routing.module.* - Check Express/NestJS: host-project/src/**/routes*, host-project/src/**/*.controller.* d. Replace any unrecognized or incorrect URL paths with the correct ones found in source e. If the correct path cannot be determined from source, add a TODO comment in the spec

review.fix-if-needed: For every failed check, edit the file to fix the issue before marking this step complete: - E2E-1 → move the files to the correct path; never write to host project - E2E-2 → convert any TypeScript syntax to plain JavaScript - E2E-3/E2E-4 → fix POM constructor and locator patterns - E2E-5/E2E-6 → fix import path and test structure - E2E-7/E2E-8 → add missing test cases for uncovered ACs and negative scenarios - E2E-9 → replace hardcoded URLs with `baseURL` references - E2E-10 → replace arbitrary waits with proper Playwright waiters - E2E-11 → add missing assertions to each test - E2E-12 → for each unrecognized URL path: read host project source (router files, pages/, app/) to find the real route; update the spec with the correct path After all fixes, re-read both files and confirm all checks pass.

step.output:
✅ E2E files generated and reviewed: - Page Object: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/pages/{suite_name}.page.js - Spec: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/tests/{suite_name}.spec.js
**Next step:** Run [RT] Run Tests to execute these tests in {test_mode} mode.
